id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Point-to-point streaming audio bus; one transmitter + one receiver per SD direction. SCK + WS are broadcast from the controller.

supported_topologies.name: Single transmitter + single receiver
supported_topologies.description: Most common case; 3 wires connect two ICs.

supported_topologies.name: Single transmitter + multiple receivers
supported_topologies.description: Multiple receivers share the same SCK + WS + SD bus (broadcast).

supported_topologies.name: Multiple transmitters, MUX'd via system controller
supported_topologies.description: Less common; requires external multiplexing of SD per active transmitter — protocol itself has no arbitration.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Drives SCK + WS. May be the transmitter, the receiver, or a separate system controller.
Receives SCK + WS as inputs. May be transmitter or receiver.
Drives SD output. May be controller (drives SCK+WS too) or target (receives external SCK+WS).
Receives SD input. May be controller or target.

fields.interconnect_role: There is no protocol-layer interconnect (no router / bridge). The bus is a flat 3-wire bus between a controller and one or more targets.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_word: Bits transmitted MSB-first; receiver reassembles bits in the same order.
ordering_guarantees.across_channels: Channels are strictly time-multiplexed; controller's WS edge defines channel boundary; transmitter must align word MSB to one SCK period after WS.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — I2S is a streaming-only protocol; no addressable regions.

device_classification.audio_DAC: Receiver target; receives audio samples via SD.
device_classification.audio_ADC: Transmitter; drives SD with sampled audio.
device_classification.digital_signal_processor: Both transmitter and receiver; typically the system controller of a multi-codec audio path.
device_classification.audio_bridge: Transmitter + receiver pair connected back-to-back, possibly with sample-rate conversion.
